entities.summary: Notre-Dame-de-la-Croix de Ménilmontant is a Roman Catholic parish church located in Ménilmontant, in the 20th arrondissement of Paris, France. It was built between 1863 and 1880. Of exceptional height and length, it is one of the largest churches in Paris.
